minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, April 20, 2022
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, April 20, 2022.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Bette Donovan and
  Scott Snider.
  Members absent: Jenny Jolly.
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.
  Guests present: Shawn Igoe, Public Works Director.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, February 16,
  2022 meeting. Motion carried.
  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, there was an average of 103
  participants per week in February and an average of 119 meals distributed per week
  in March. The La Verne Community Center kitchen was inspected as a requirement
  for resuming congregate meals later this year. A leak was discovered and fixed;
  everything else is okay. A site manager and volunteers are needed to resume meals
  in late August or September. Upon opening, there will be a vaccination requirement.
  Volunteers will need to be vaccinated against Covid-19 and a flu shot will be
  required as well.

3. Guest Speaker: Shawn Igoe, Public Works Director.
  Shawn provided information regarding the responsibilities of the Public Works
  Department. He also advised that White Street will reopen when the LA County Fair
  starts.

4. Bingo Report: There was an average of 42 players in February and March.
  Attendance on Good Friday was down so it has been taken into consideration to
  cancel Bingo on Good Friday 2023. New table covers were purchased for $200 and
  paper stock has been replenished. Additionally, payments were made to Bingo
  West in the amounts of $443.00 in February and $532 in March. The Bingo display
  is currently having problems. The current Bingo balance is $2,774.35.

5. Meals on Wheels: 766 meals were served to 50 La Verne recipients in February
  2022 and 865 meals were served to 47 La Verne recipients in March.
 6. Account Balance: $4,731.00

7. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid with the exception of Garden Friends.

8. MT. SAC Classes: Summer classes begin in June and will run through August. In
  person Request to Register will be held on May 9th. Online Request to Register is
  also available May 1st through May 27th.

9. Aging Next: 19 La Verne residents received case management in February and 42
  La Verne residents received case management in March. Aging next will be asked to
  be a guest speaker at the next S.A.C. meeting.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
   Tuesday, April 26th – Senior Scrapbooking, 4:00-8:00PM
   Monday, May 9th– Movie Matinee, 12:30PM
   Friday, May 13th– Mindfulness & Meditation Senior Seminar, 12:30PM
   Sunday, May 15th – Havana Nights Dinner Dance Extravaganza, 4:00-
  7:00PM
   Tuesday, May 24th – Volunteer Recognition Brunch, Time TBD

11. Facilities Report: The La Verne Aquatic Center had a broken pipe and the diving
  board needs repair. Additionally, the pool needs to be re-plastered and the heaters
  need repair. The maintenance cost is shared by the University of La Verne; they pay
  2/3 of the amount for repair.

12. Older Americans Month: Yvonne announced the City Council will be recognizing the
  Older Americans at the May 16th Council meeting. All S.A.C. members are invited to
  attend.

13. Public Comments: Scott provided updates on Hillcrest and shared that the dining
  room needs to be remodeled. Yvonne announced a new website for the City will
  launch on April 28th. Accounts can be created to receive updates, etc. There will
  also be a page for senior programs. Amanda discussed new excursions that will be
  coming up in June, July and August. George provided an update on Senior Golf.
  The league continues to have an average of 20 players participate. A date will be set
  in May for the SAC luncheon, which is normally held in December.

14. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:20 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, May 18, 2022 at 10:00 AM.
